entries.summary: The autonomous loop and named-agent dispatcher moved from Bash into Node.js.
entries.why: Targets on native Windows could run the baseline but still needed Git Bash or WSL for the autonomous loop.
entries.targetImpact: Core target orchestration now runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through one implementation; shell and cmd files are compatibility wrappers only.
mergeActions: Preserve project-specific goals, commands and permissions in customized files.
Replace workflow instructions that invoke run-loop.sh or dispatch.sh with node loop/run-loop.mjs or node loop/dispatch.mjs.
Regenerate every runtime from agents.manifest.json after prompt merges.
verification: node loop/run-loop.mjs --headless exits cleanly when all features are settled

entries.summary: Harness updates now carry canonical upgrade context into the onboarder's merge plan.
entries.why: Changed and drifted filename lists forced the onboarder to rediscover why a harness behavior changed and how target customizations should be reconciled.
entries.targetImpact: Upgrade plans now retain the relevant reason, compatibility impact, merge actions and verification; a plan cannot pass while that context is unread or unacknowledged.
mergeActions: Refresh the harness-owned upgrade capability before final plan validation.
Rebuild an old plan if its source report contains context IDs the plan omitted.
Record an explicit target disposition for every applicable context entry.
verification: node skills/harness-upgrade/scripts/check-upgrade-plan.mjs <plan> rejects missing or unacknowledged source context

entries.summary: User-scope skill installation now includes an always-loaded Kiro steering bridge.
entries.why: A globally copied skill remained passive: Kiro agents could complete a turn without seeing its activation rule.
entries.targetImpact: Kiro loads a thin global trigger for each installed harness user skill while the full workflow remains in the versioned SKILL.md.
mergeActions: Install or refresh each user skill and its Kiro steering bridge outside the target repository.
Preserve local EXTEND.md customization before using --force.
If a Kiro custom agent disables default-resource inheritance, explicitly include the global steering resource.
verification: Confirm ~/.kiro/steering/harness-skill-<name>.md uses inclusion: always and points to the installed SKILL.md.

entries.summary: The interactive orchestrator now uses native sub-agent spawn as its primary execution mode.
entries.why: Routing an interactive orchestration session back through a CLI script discarded the runtime's native parent-child coordination and made result collection indirect.
entries.targetImpact: The router still chooses exactly one node, but orchestrator spawns that named role in-session and waits for it; Node dispatch remains available for headless, CI and unsupported runtimes.
mergeActions: Merge the native-spawn-first orchestrator contract without weakening route.mjs ownership.
Regenerate runtime agent files from agents.manifest.json.
Keep loop/dispatch.mjs and loop/run-loop.mjs for unattended execution and fallback.
verification: The orchestrator prompt requires the exact router-named role, one active child and post-spawn state inspection.
